items.title: Trump says Iranian football players 'taken care of' in their bid for asylum
items.description: Fears have been growing they will be targeted by the Iranian regime upon their return, after they were labelled "traitors" on Iranian TV for not singing the national anthem.

items.title: Live: France and allies preparing to escort ships through Strait of Hormuz
items.description: Iranian missiles are intercepted over Türkiye, Qatar and United Arab Emirates, as war in the Middle East continues. Follow live.

items.title: 'Every war game': The problem with the US strategy in Iran
items.description: A former top US diplomat says her country's efforts to topple Iran's leadership risks destabilising the region and strengthening the nation's Revolutionary Guard.

items.title: In the early hours of the Iran war, Indonesia's president made a telling offer
items.description: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto's big ambitions on the world stage and at home have alarmed his critics.

items.title: Struggling trucking industry hit by higher petrol prices
items.description: Transport companies are at risk of shutting due to the cost of petrol, as global oil prices spike.

items.title: Labor MP warns linking Israeli government to antisemitism is 'dangerous'
items.description: Josh Burns also acknowledged the government had not always acted fast enough to deal with antisemitism and said it was necessary to be "humble" in the wake of the Bondi terror attack.

items.title: The network of Liberals behind two 'grassroots' childcare campaigns
items.description: The childcare groups say they are the voices for everyday parents. What they don't mention is that they are supported by a network of current and former Liberals.

items.title: Thousands of melatonin bottles intercepted at border over safety concerns
items.description: Australian Border Force officials have intercepted more than 150,000 units of melatonin in four months, after authorities warned they would crackdown on unregulated products.

items.title: Will this year’s flu vaccine protect against the fast-moving Super- K strain?
items.description: Experts say they are feeling "nervous" as Australia approached this year's flu season, with a new, fast-moving strain of influenza dubbed "Super-K" circulating as vaccine uptake dwindles.

items.title: Katherine locals survey flood damage as volunteers rally to help
items.description: An "army" of volunteers has hit the streets of Katherine to help residents worst affected by the weekend's flooding, as they survey the damage from near-record river rises.

items.title: Decline in GP home visits drives vulnerable people into care homes
items.description: The number of GP home visits has declined by 85 per cent in Australia over the past three decades, which doctors say is driving vulnerable people into residential care and hospital prematurely.

items.title: Bomb found near Mamdani's home 'act of ISIS-inspired terrorism', police say
items.description: A homemade bomb thrown near an anti-Islam protest in New York at the weekend is being investigated as an Islamic State-inspired act of "terrorism," police say.

items.title: Bondi Beach gunman seeks to suppress family's identity over safety concerns
items.description: Naveed Akram faces 59 charges, including 15 counts of murder and one of committing a terrorist attack, over the shooting on December 14.

items.title: Lions to contest three-match ban handed to Andrews over swinging arm
items.description: Brisbane begins its season with two pivotal cases at the AFL tribunal in a bid to not have its defensive stocks completely depleted heading into the first month.

items.title: From cattle stations to city streets, how cowboy fashion went mainstream
items.description: From streetwear to festival fits, country fashion has become mainstream in Australian cities and heritage brands are reaping the benefits.

items.title: Maggie Gyllenhaal's Franken-feminist fable fumbles the plot
items.description: The Bride!, a modern retelling of The Bride of Frankenstein, takes massive swings in terms of performances, plotting and subtext, but not all of its gambles pay off.

items.title: ABC Shakespeare quiz: How well doest thou know his characters and quotes?
items.description: A quiz by any other word would smell as sweet, or something, so have a crack at our 10 questions on the works of William Shakespeare.

items.title: The 'quite terrifying' scenarios that finally spooked global markets
items.description: For more than a year, traders have been pushing markets higher on the hopes of an AI-powered economic miracle and the notion of TACO — Trump Always Chickens Out. Now it looks like the penny has dropped.

items.title: Swiss prosecutors expand ski bar fatal fire probe to include mayor
items.description: Swiss prosecutors have added the mayor to those under criminal investigation for a fatal New Years Eve ski resort fire that killed 41 people.

items.title: Bali scooter crash leaves 'vibrant' mum fighting for life
items.description: A mother of two from the NSW Central Coast was holidaying in Bali with her girlfriends when she was hit by a truck while riding a scooter.

items.title: Australians in Bali sentenced for murder of Melbourne father
items.description: An Indonesian court has jailed two Australian men for 16 years for the murder of Zivan Radmanovic, 32, in June last year.

items.title: Age verification for R-rated games and websites raises privacy concerns
items.description: New online safety codes requiring R-rated games and websites to verify their users' ages come into effect, prompting concerns about online privacy.

items.title: Calls for wild deer to be labelled a pest as population grows
items.description: The Tasmanian government asked the public what it thought about how wild fallow deer were being managed. It received hundreds of submissions calling for deer to be labelled a pest and for improved zoning and hunting permits.

items.title: A career break gave one woman a 'safety net' to return to her job
items.description: Whether it’s for a holiday, additional study or a exploring a new field of work, experts say a career break can have many benefits.

items.title: Farmers warn grocery prices could rise as war sparks fuel supply fears
items.description: Farmers say consumers could soon feel the impact of fuel shortages and soaring prices at the checkout, as the closure of the Strait of Hormuz disrupts global supply chains.
